auditor_value: tanθ = tanα + tanβ, proved from y = x tanθ(1 − x/R) with tanα = y/x and tanβ = y/(R − x)
notes: Independent proof follows the same route; checked numerically (u = 20 m/s, θ = 50°, x = 0.3R: tanθ = 1.1918 = tanα + tanβ). The identity g/(2u²cos²θ) = tanθ/R in step 1 is correct. The mistake entry (x = R/2 special case) is a genuine error.
